in_sanskrit.name: Ramalingam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rama - God; Lingam - Symbol of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ramalingam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ramalingam is a name of God in Hinduism. It is a combination of the words Rama and Lingam. Rama refers to the God Vishnu in his incarnation as Rama, while Lingam is a symbol of Shiva. The name signifies the unity of these two important deities in Hinduism.
